tools.name: rounding_impact
tools.description:
Compute what cash rounding is actually worth across a list of prices: mean delta per transaction, the up/down/unchanged split, and a per-thousand figure.

Use this whenever someone asks whether rounding costs or earns money — a very common question and one usually answered with a guess. Do not guess

tools.name: price_band
tools.description:
For a list price and a tax rate, find every nearby list price that settles to the SAME cash total, and the highest one.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "round_cash_total" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Settle a transaction under post-penny cash rounding: exact subtotal, tax on the exact subtotal, then round the final total to the nearest nickel — and only for …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "round_cash_total" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: round_cash_total · Public sink: round_cash_total.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: round_cash_total · Public sink: round_cash_total

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
